extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants, peer reviewers, NIH staff, and institutional administrators involved in NIH peer review and compliance
extracted.subtask_description: Official NIH policies and resources describing the legal framework, policy requirements, reviewer guidance, scoring, conflict-of-interest management, confidentiality, and procedural rules that govern peer review of NIH grant and contract applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two levels of peer review requirement (PHS Act 42 U.S.C. 289a)
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS Act 42 U.S.C. 289a requires that applications undergo two levels of peer review for a grant award to be made by the NIH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority for appropriate scientific and technical peer review (PHS Act 42 U.S.C. 284a)
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS Act 42 U.S.C. 284a authorizes appropriate scientific and technical peer review through advisory committees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal Advisory Committee Act (FACA) provisions for advisory committees
rubrics_metrics.description: The Federal Advisory Committee Act lays out the provisions for how NIH peer review advisory committees are to be established and managed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government in the Sunshine Act requirements for meeting openness
rubrics_metrics.description: The Government in the Sunshine Act directs when advisory committee meetings may be closed or partially closed to the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: 42 CFR 52h - Scientific Peer Review rules
rubrics_metrics.description: 42 C.F.R. 52h (Scientific Peer Review of Research Grant Applications and Research and Development Contract Projects) establishes the rules for how applications submitted to NIH must be evaluated and how NIH peer review meetings are conducted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrity and Confidentiality in NIH Peer Review
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH policy and resources addressing integrity and confidentiality in peer review, including policy notices and FAQs about maintaining security and confidentiality in NIH peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page references: 'Integrity and Confidentiality in NIH Peer Review'; policy notice 'Maintaining Security and Confidentiality in NIH Peer Review: Rules, Responsibilities and Possible Consequences (NOT-OD-22-044)'; FAQs: Confidentiality in Peer Review. Emphasizes maintaining security and confidentiality and outlines possible consequences for breaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on use of generative AI in NIH peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: The Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence Technologies is Prohibited for the NIH Peer Review Process (NOT-OD-23-149).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page includes FAQs: 'Use of Generative AI in Peer Review' clarifying the prohibition and related guidance for reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Managing Conflict of Interest in NIH Peer Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies and notices governing identification and management of conflicts of interest in the initial peer review of NIH grant and cooperative agreement applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page references: 'Advance Notice: Revised Policy for Managing Conflict of Interest in the Initial Peer Review of NIH Grant and Cooperative Agreement Applications (NOT-OD-13-010)'; FAQs: 'Peer Review Conflict of Interest (COI)'. Guidance covers how COI is handled in peer review panels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer Review Criteria and Considerations / Simplified Peer Review Framework
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources and policies describing review criteria and considerations, including the Simplified Review Framework for NIH Research Project Grant Applications and related reviewer and applicant guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page links: 'Peer Review Criteria and Considerations', 'Simplified Review Framework', 'Simplified Review Framework for NIH Research Project Grant Applications' (NOT-OD-24-010), and 'Applicant Guidance for Simplifying the Review Framework for Most Research Project Grants'. Also references revisions to fellowship review criteria and implementation notices. Use these resources for what reviewers should evaluate and how criteria are applied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scoring in First Level Peer Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies and notices describing scoring procedures used in first-level peer review of NIH applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page references: 'Scoring in First Level Peer Review'; policy notice 'Enhancing Peer Review: The NIH Announces New Scoring Procedures for Evaluation of Research Applications (NOT-OD-09-024)'; and FAQs on scoring. These documents explain how applications are scored and any procedural scoring changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals of NIH initial peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy and guidance governing appeals in the first-level peer review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page references: 'Appeals of NIH Initial Peer Review (NOT-OD-11-064)' and FAQs: 'Applicant Guidance: Next Steps'. Provides procedural guidance for applicants seeking to appeal initial review outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core Values of NIH Peer Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement(s) of the core values that NIH expects peer review to embody (linked as 'Core Values of NIH Peer Review (PDF)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page lists Core Values resource and related videos; use this resource to understand foundational expectations (integrity, fairness, confidentiality, etc.) for the peer review process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer guidance and consolidated reviewer documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Centralized guidance for reviewers covering individual steps of the review process and a consolidated list of reviewer documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page notes: 'Reviewer guidance for individual steps of the review process can be found on the Consolidated List of Reviewer Documents webpage.' Use this consolidated list for step-by-step reviewer instructions and forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation notices and revisions to fellowship review process
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices and guidance regarding revisions to NIH and AHRQ fellowship application and review processes, including changes to fellowship review criteria and sponsor/candidate guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page references: 'Implementation of Revisions to the NIH and AHRQ Fellowship Application and Review Process (NOT-OD-24-107)' and related FAQs and guidance for sponsors, candidates, and reviewers.
